description: This file defines the internal class `LibraryTypes` within the Orleans code generator. It manages and provides metadata about types used in Orleans serialization, code generation, and reflection, including type symbols, known codecs, copiers, attributes, and utility methods to determine type characteristics such as shallow copyability.

classes.name: LibraryTypes
classes.description: Encapsulates type symbols, known codecs, attributes, and utility methods for Orleans code generation and serialization.

methods.name: FromCompilation
methods.description: Creates an instance of LibraryTypes from a compilation and options.

methods.name: IsShallowCopyable
methods.description: Determines if a given type symbol is shallow copyable based on predefined rules and attributes.
